components.name: Map button

components.name: Directory search

components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="5"/><path d="m12 12 5 5"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Search entities" placeholder="Find someone or somewhere"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid #cdd4c4; background: #fffef9; padding: 10px 9px; } .ds-search svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; stroke: #647667; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.5; flex: none; } .ds-search input { font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: none; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink, #263d38); caret-color: #a27332; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #69766a; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c89740; outline-offset: 8px; }

components.name: Directory row
components.description: Selected person with role and current activity.
components.css: .ds-button { font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: 0; transition: background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c89740; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } } .ds-row { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e8dc; text-align: left; padding: 12px 3px; min-height: 54px; color: var(--ink, #263d38); } .ds-row:hover { background: #eaf0e3; } .ds-row[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #e4eaca; } .ds-row-copy { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-row small { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted, #62716a); margin-top: 4px; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-person { position: relative; display: block; flex: none; width: 10px; height: 12px; background: #7a9770; margin: 0 3px; } .ds-person:before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 6px; height: 5px; background: #b69a6c; top: -5px; left: 2px; } .ds-activity { color: var(--muted, #62716a); font-size: 10px; }

narrative.overview:
The user-selected pixel-art world is the visual center: a blue sea, stepped sandy coastline, green land and distinct little village landmarks. Original cached bitmap sprites give people, workplaces and resources recognizable silhouettes. The surrounding interface is a quiet, warm paper surface for reading current simulation facts.

The pixel title establishes the world's character; utility text stays readable in a familiar sans serif. Map controls and inspection are deliberately modest. Status language reports the freshness of the source file, including stale or interrupted states.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp original pixel artwork and square geometry.
Green, sand and sea world colors beside warm paper and dark green ink.
Pixel identity paired with compact, readable operator text.
Map-led desktop layout that becomes a vertical flow on phones.
Selection and freshness states remain explicit in text.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Pair freshness color with the actual connection message; a rendered map can be retained while its snapshot is stale.

rules.name: The Readable Utility Rule
rules.body: Keep the pixel face for the identity; retain the sans-serif hierarchy for detailed inspection and controls.

dos: Do preserve crisp nearest-neighbor rendering and original bitmap landmark silhouettes.
Do keep detailed utility text in Segoe UI and reserve Silkscreen for the identity.
Do preserve explicit selected, pressed, focus and freshness states.
Do keep the map first and let inspection flow below it on narrow screens.
Do keep camera, labels, search and selection controls read-only.
donts: Don't smooth or blur the pixel artwork when scaling the map.
Don't imply a stale retained snapshot is live.
Don't turn view controls into simulation or gameplay commands.
Don't replace the continuous paper sidebar with decorative floating cards.
